correctness.rationale: For every field satisfying q-1=2^a ℓ, non-square means odd primitive exponent and nonprimitive forces ℓ-divisibility, so NSNP set is precisely roots of X^(2^(a-1))+1. The latter is squarefree and splits in F_q, making the count the gcd degree over F_p. Separately rechecked exact integer Sylvester determinants (a=1..4), their factors, and Euclidean gcds at each prime. Elementary v_2 identities and odd-cofactor factorizations prove the sole permissible positive cases; no finite numerical search is used for the universal claim. The packaged exact-arithmetic program was executed and reproduced six field examples.

value.rationale: The high-primitive-density single-odd-prime order regime (θ=(ℓ-1)/(2ℓ)>1/3 for ℓ≥5) is outside the motivating 2026 existence threshold. The complete first-four-2-adic-stratum classification gives non-obvious zero families (especially all a=3), exact positive 1/2/4-pair families, and characteristic-locality independent of field size. The example q=4913 has four consecutive pairs among only eight NSNP elements; the exact prime-power conditional classification, not recomputation of tabulated resultants, is the natural invariant of interest. No claim to higher strata or cofactor-prime infinitude.
